title: PhysicsOptimizer
description: One constrained design problem through one interface, six optimizers. Torsional rigidity of an a x b rectangle is the integral of u for -laplace(u) = 1, u = 0 on the boundary (solved by the differentiable finite-element solver). Maximise it at fixed area a*b = 1, with 0.5 <= a, b <= 2: among rectangles of equal area the square is the best, so the answer is a = b = 1. PYTHONPATH=. python examples/p
